description: This PHP source file defines functions for managing and interacting with schema files and UI elements in the OpenX Schema Management Utility, including AJAX request handling, schema loading, UI element expansion/collapse, and audit row expansion.

methods.name: onclickUpOrDown
methods.description: Handles UI toggle for up/down icons based on parameter.

methods.name: oxAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert with the event message.

methods.name: loadSchemaList
methods.description: Loads list of schema XML files from directories into a dropdown.

methods.name: loadChangeset
methods.description: Loads and displays a list of change set XML files.

methods.name: loadSchema
methods.description: Loads and displays schema XML files.

methods.name: loadDatasetList
methods.description: Loads list of dataset XML files.

methods.name: editTableProperty
methods.description: Switches UI to edit mode for table properties.

methods.name: exitTableProperty
methods.description: Exits edit mode for table properties.

methods.name: editFieldProperty
methods.description: Switches UI to edit mode for field properties.

methods.name: exitFieldProperty
methods.description: Exits edit mode for field properties.

methods.name: editIndexProperty
methods.description: Enables editing of index properties in UI.

methods.name: addIndexField
methods.description: Adds a new field to index configuration in UI.

methods.name: expandOSURow
methods.description: Expands a row to show audit backup table details.

methods.name: collapseOSURow
methods.description: Collapses a row showing audit backup table details.

methods.name: expandRow
methods.description: Expands a row to show detailed audit information.
